paper_title: A torsion-balance search for ultra low-mass bosonic dark matter
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_BL (hbar*c)^{-1/2}, i.e. standard dimensionless g_{B-L}
notes: Eot-Wash stationary torsion-balance search (Shaw et al., arXiv:2109.08822) for B-L coupled vector ultralight dark matter with Be-Al composition dipole. Best limit explicitly stated in abstract: g_BL < 1e-25 at m = 8e-18 eV (near resonance f0 = 1.934 mHz). Other data points reconstructed from the paper's stated frequency scaling of the limits (1/sqrt(f) below resonance, proportional to f above resonance) over the quoted validity range 1e-18 to 1e-16 eV; exact curve is in Fig. 5 which could not be digitized, so intermediate points are approximate. Assumes rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. 95% CL via Rice distribution.
